parameters.name: AcceptLanguage
parameters.description:
The language of the response.
Defaults to `zh-CN` for services in Chinese mainland and `en-US` for other regions.

parameters.name: DynamicSql
parameters.description: Indicates if the SQL statement specified by `SqlId` is dynamic SQL. >

parameters.name: EndTime
parameters.description:
The end of the query period.
The time must be in UTC and formatted as `YYYY-MM-DDTHH:mm:ssZ`.

parameters.name: FilterCondition
parameters.description: Use the at sign (@) to reference fields. For a list of available fields, see all columns returned by the [Query performance statistics for an SQL statement](https://www.oceanbase.com/docs/community-ocp-cn-10000000001832433) API.

parameters.name: InstanceId
parameters.description: The ID of the OceanBase instance.

parameters.name: MergeDynamicSql
parameters.description:
Whether to merge the results of dynamic SQL statements.

> This option aggregates SQL statements that are identical except for the values in their `IN` clauses.

parameters.name: NodeIp
parameters.description: The IP address of the node.

parameters.name: PageSize
parameters.description:
The number of entries to return on each page.

- Minimum value: 1.

- Default value: 10.

parameters.name: SearchParam
parameters.description: The performance metric to search by.

parameters.name: SearchRule
parameters.description:
The search operator.
Valid values: `=`, `>`, `>=`, `<`, and `<=`.

parameters.name: SqlTextLength
parameters.description: The maximum length of the returned SQL text.

parameters.name: StartTime
parameters.description:
The beginning of the query period.
The time must be in UTC and formatted as `YYYY-MM-DDTHH:mm:ssZ`.
